name: claude-telemetry
description: Local observability for Claude Code: a stdlib OTLP/HTTP-JSON sink that writes live metrics, events and traces into SQLite, a backfill that imports the transcripts already on disk, and an MCP server that queries both. Answers cost, audit and per-plugin attribution questions without sending telemetry anywhere. No collector, no protobuf, no dependencies, loopback only. Not for hosted observability backends, and not a replacement for the Claude Code analytics dashboard.
